desk-look passes the plugin directory's policy check again.

- The directory refused 0.55.3 with `MOD_CAPABILITY_USE_NOT_PLAIN` on the `turn.step` hook, which handed `$` to a helper inside a `yield*`. The helper now takes a save callback instead of `$`; nothing changes on screen

## Install

```
/plugin install desk-look --marketplace KyongSik-Yoon/cc-desktop-mod
/plugin install desk-asana@cc-desktop-mod
/plugin install desk-slack@cc-desktop-mod
```

Already installed: `/desk-update` (or `claude plugin update desk-look`), then `/reload-plugins`.
